Name: First Strike
Description:
Grants **First Strike** when entering combat.
**First Strike Effect: **Weaponskill cast time and recast time, spell cast time and recast time, and auto-attack delay are reduced
**Duration: **25s

Name: Enhanced Occult Jump
Description: Increases potency of **Occult Jump** to 500, and increases potency of reduced damage taken effect to 90%.

Name: Occult Learning I
Description:
**Occult Missile** and **Occult Aqua Breath** are now learnable actions.
**Missile Effect: **Delivers an attack with a 35% chance to deal damage equal to 75% of target's current HP, with some exceptions
**Occult Aqua Breath Effect: **Deals unaspected damage to target and all enemies nearby it

Name: Occult Learning II
Description:
**Occult Aero II** and **Occult Mighty Guard** are now learnable actions.
**Occult Aero II Effect: **Deals wind damage to target
**Occult Mighty Guard Effect: **Reduces damage taken by self and nearby party members by 20%

Name: Occult Learning III
Description:
**Occult White Wind** is now a learnable action.
**Occult White Wind Effect: **Restores own HP and the HP of all nearby party members by an amount equal to your current HP
If **Occult Aero II** has already been learned, **Occult Aero III** can also be learned.
**Occult Aero III Effect: **Deals wind damage to target and all enemies nearby it

Name: Dualcast
Description:
Grants the effect of **Dualcast** upon casting any spell with a cast time. While under the effect of **Dualcast**, your next spell will require no time to cast. Effect is canceled upon execution of any action other than an ability. Auto-attacks do not cancel effect.
**Duration: **15s

Name: Adaptable
Description: Allows the changing of phantom jobs when normally prohibited, as well as during combat.
